name: Wingspan
body:
School transmutation; Level druid/shaman 1, ranger 1, sorcerer/wizard 1, summoner 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target flying creature touched
Duration 10 min./level
Saving Throw Fort negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

A creature benefiting from this spell has a greater wingspan, although its size does not change. This grants a 10-ft. increase to the target’s fly speed and improves its maneuverability class one step.
